title: Her Daily Routine: Naming Her Friends

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a few days since I met Aston
Machan and took a video for
her. I'm on
my way home from a shopping trip, when...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Little Floofy, you're so floofy. You're so
floofy, you make me feel all
floofy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I happen to bump into her, and for some
reason, she's sitting down
talking to a
white pigeon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I've met you before. You're the
trainer who took a video for me,
right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Machan never forgets. Once I meet
you, I remember forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sounds like she genuinely means it.
The white pigeon next to her
coos in
agreement.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, this is my friend. Well, I say friend,
but we've only just met.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was taking a nap, and when I woke up,
Little Floofy was here
sleeping next to me.
That's how we got to talking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(A wild pigeon just decided to sleep next
to her? Is that a thing?)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm not sure, but since Chloe
Harvard lives around here, she
might've
told Little Floofy about me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh wait, it could've been Hattori
Shinobimaru. Or Antley maybe?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Would you like to meet them?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes me down to the end of the
shopping street to meet the first
of her
friends.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Chloe! You look well as always!
How is your baby doing?

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caaaw!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hattori Shinobimaru! Hehe, it's the perfect
weather for a nap in the
sun, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Mrrreooow.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're so hardworking, Antley. Have you
found any more food?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Maybe you should take a little
break, then.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! There's something I want to show
you, Antley. It's Machan's
special surprise.
Want to see it? Okay.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's a secret.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the ant on one hand, she takes us
to the Umamusume merch
store in town.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ouch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They still don't have any Machan dolls.
Not only that, they don't have
any merch
of me at all. I wanted to show Antley...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought I made a big impression at
tryouts the other day. I guess it's
not that
easy to become a super ultra mascot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit early for merch considering she
hasn't even debuted yet, but
putting that
aside... This isn't the first time she's
brought up the
subject of being a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: My dream... is to become a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I want to appear everywhere, by everybody's side, and be a super—no—a super ultra mascot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her scan the store, I'm starting
to believe she was actually
being serious
about becoming a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Most Umamusume do it because they love
running or dream of
winning a specific
race. For some, it's about working hard
and
fulfilling their potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But debuting in the racing world for the
sole purpose of having merch
is really
unusual. I don't get what's behind it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's my number-one mission—an Aston
Machan in every house. I'd love
to make
that a reality someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to notice a pattern... She never
really seems to give a
straight answer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The idea? That came to me... a few years
ago. When I was just a little
smaller than I
am now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's something mysterious about her
facial expression as she starts
recounting
her story.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was stuck with a problem. I had just
finished making my Machan
dolls, but I
didn't know how to get them out to the
public.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how I can get them into
everyone's hands. I could give them
out
one by one, but there has to be a more
original and efficient way
of doing it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
All press is good press! I'll cause a scandal
to get myself all over the
tabloids! ...No,
wait. I don't want to be known as
Mischievous
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll study business instead! Yes, that might
work. That way I can learn
the best
strategy while I come up with my plan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't come up with any good ideas.
But then one day, I just so
happened to go
into an Umamusume merch shop.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And what I saw was... miniature
Umamusume dolls, flying off the
shelves
one after another!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It was eye-opening! Until then, I had no
idea that active racers could
be such
popular mascots!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They're mascots loved by all... So, maybe,
that means... I could be
one too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, that's how Machan entered Tracen
Academy and set her
sights on the Twinkle
Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've gathered that she entered Tracen to
get her own merch, and how
much that
merch means to her, but what I still don't
understand is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't tell whether she forgot to share the
most important part of the
story, or if she
dodged the question, but either way, she
hasn't
answered it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The dream is to expand nationwide, and
then worldwide. So outside
of racing, I'm
also studying bookkeeping. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, I've been lovable ever since I
was born, so I'm sure it'll all
go well as
long as I debut and win my races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being the only explanation that seems to
make sense right now, I
draw that
conclusion by the end of our encounter.
